name: MPIRE Raycasting on Tera MTA
definition: A massively parallel raycasting implementation for the Tera MTA architecture, utilizing a flat global memory model and hardware multithreading to hide memory latency. It avoids the pixel composition step required by distributed-memory machines like the Cray T3E.
summary: MPIRE is a massively parallel direct volume raycasting implementation for the Tera MTA that eliminates pixel composition and message passing overhead by leveraging a flat global memory model.
